finalFocusedRerun.scope: All route transformation previews/saves and all three grid modes, desktop + mobile, on final API image

limitations: 88 distinct cases passed across multiple runs; the initial full run was terminated with SIGTERM before producing a complete report.
Two initial map timeouts were investigated: coverage cases passed when run separately; the owner grid test now waits for the asynchronous editor transition and selects the mounted map.
No single uninterrupted 88-case run was repeated after the final fixes; the final targeted run passed all 12 affected cases.
Playwright MCP unavailable; existing Playwright CLI used with real Chromium and console/network diagnostics.
External OSRM/map quality and physical devices were not tested; deterministic fixtures and Pixel 7 emulation were used.
